say:2:1330333001:1.text: The place's safe, of course! I've been hunting around here for ages and never heard of any beast attacks there.
say:2:1330333001:1.source_cn: 当然是因为那里安全了！我在附近打猎这么久，还没听说过温...
say:2:1330333001:1.male: The place's safe, of course! I've been hunting around here for ages and never heard of any beast attacks there.
say:2:1330333001:1.female: The place's safe, of course! I've been hunting around here for ages and never heard of any beast attacks there.

say:3:1330333002:1.text: The inn's crowded all the time—that's why the beasts stay away.
say:3:1330333002:1.source_cn: 温泉旅店里总是那么多人，野兽当然不敢靠近。
say:3:1330333002:1.male: The inn's crowded all the time—that's why the beasts stay away.
say:3:1330333002:1.female: The inn's crowded all the time—that's why the beasts stay away.
